# Project context

* This repository is hosted on GitHub.com at https://github.com/herdworks/hyperfeed-go
* Always refer to README.md for a description of this project's goals and its primary purpose
* For additional information, please familiarize yourself with the following resources:
  * https://makehypertext.com
  * https://hypertemplates.net
  * https://hypertexting.com
  * https://hypertexting.community

## Core differentiation

* HyperTemplates guarantees valid HTML5 output
* HyperTemplates guarantees reproducible HTML outputs
* HyperTemplates should be fast in terms of absolutely minimal overhead (for running on mobile devices)
* HyperTemplates should be extremely fast in terms of raw performance (for large website projects)
* As a pure-HTML templating engine, HyperTemplates should reward users for writing semantic HTML
* As a pure-HTML templating engine, HyperTemplates provides power tools for managing inline CSS (style elements)

## Non-differentiation

* HTML formatting or "pretty printing"
* CSS selector support
* Deployment providers (S3, Git, SSH/SFTP, etc)

## Project priorities

* As a low-level HTML templating engine, performance and consistency are critical
